①Installed Applications/Packages. When you use التطبيق الموازي, we collect your installed applications/packages information to provide you with a customized list of recommended apps that can be cloned and relevant compatibility notes. ②Primary Account. When you log in to your primary account in our app, we will collect your main account information to our server. We do not share your primary account information with any third party. Such information is collected, uploaded, and used for the sole purpose of confirming your that your VIP information is accurate and granting the premium feature to you.
③Crash Logs. We track and retain logs regarding crashes users experience while using the التطبيق الموازي. These logs contain information about the error types, timestamp that the error occurred, and general device information listed above. Crash information is necessary for us to better understand issues users are encountering during standard use of our service, and allows us to address technical problems more effectively. No personal information is stored in crash logs."
